$comment: The UI strings the library needs. The library ships no interface strings of its own beyond these readable English defaults; applications override them with `app.use(JinUI, { t })`. Keys must stay business-free.

a11y.close.description: Close button / dismiss affordance on any overlay

a11y.clear.description: Clear the current value of an input

a11y.menu.description: Menu trigger when no visible label exists

a11y.navigation.description: Landmark label for a navigation list

a11y.tabs.description: Accessible name for a tab list without a visible label

a11y.toasts.description: Landmark label for the toast region

a11y.notifications.description: Landmark label for the notification region

empty.noData.description: Empty state title when nothing is available

select.noOptions.description: Shown in an empty select listbox

tree.empty.description: Shown when a tree has no nodes

tree.loadFailed.description: Inline failure text next to a tree row whose load rejected
